summary: This topic details how to define bus routes, assign vehicles to routes, specify pick-up and drop points with their respective timings and charges, and manage the skipping of transport fees for specific installments. Routes can be created manually or copied from previous sessions.
steps: Navigate to Settings icon > Transport > Vehicle Route.
To create a new route, click 'New Vehicle Route'.
Select the 'Vehicle' that will operate on this route from the dropdown list.
Optionally, select 'Skip Installment(s)' if transport fees should not be charged for particular installments (e.g., June).
Optionally, select 'Employee(s)' (drivers) to assign to this route. This data comes from the HRM employee setup.
Enter the 'Pick-up Time' and 'Drop Time' for this point.
Enter the 'Amount' associated with this pick-up point.
Optionally, enter Longitude and Latitude for GPS tracking integration.
Click 'Add' to save the complete vehicle route.
To copy routes from a previous session, click 'Copy from Session' and select the desired academic session from the dropdown.
To update an existing route, select the route from the list, click 'Edit', make the necessary changes, and click 'Update'.
To upload pick-up points in bulk, click 'Upload Pick-up Point', download the sample Excel file, fill it with the required data, choose the file, and click 'Submit'.
business_rules: The 'Skip Installment' feature allows excluding transport fees for selected installments (e.g., June for schools).
Employee data (drivers) must be pre-configured in the HRM employee setup.
Pick-up Time and Drop Time are non-mandatory when uploading pick-up points via Excel, but are mandatory when adding them manually.
important_notes: The 'Copy from Session' feature is highly useful for entities where transport routes remain largely consistent across academic sessions.
Longitude and Latitude fields are primarily for integration with GPS tracking systems.
Bulk upload via Excel is an efficient method for adding numerous pick-up points to a route. The system will generate an error file if there are invalid entries during the upload process.
You can add multiple pick-up points to a single route.
